title: Indian Railways AC Traction Manual (ACTM) Volume II (Part I) - Power Block Regulations
publisher: Electrical Directorate, Railway Board, Ministry of Railways
scope: 25 kV AC 50 Hz Single Phase Traction Overhead Equipment (OHE) Power Block Regulations

regulations.title: Power Block Definition
regulations.text: Power Block means blocking of a section of 25 kV AC line to electric traffic by switching off the power supply and earthing the OHE to permit maintenance, construction, or inspection safely.

regulations.title: Types of Power Block
regulations.text: Power Blocks are classified as: (a) Emergency Power Block, arranged immediately on breakdown; (b) Pre-arranged (Planned) Power Block, scheduled in advance with operating department; (c) Local Power Block.

regulations.title: Permit to Work (PTW)
regulations.text: No person shall work within 2 meters of any 25 kV live OHE equipment without a valid Permit to Work (PTW) issued by an authorized traction official after verifying isolation and earthing on both sides.

regulations.title: Combined Traffic and Power Block
regulations.text: When track machines (BCM, TRT, CSM tamping), rail cranes, or major civil engineering works are executed under 25 kV AC OHE, a simultaneous Traffic Block and Power Block must be granted.
